rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACrite
Exhibition name: Rio Samba ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1991).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) as 'Rio Samba'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, red outer petals, ages to red . Moderate fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright, well-branched. Medium, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 5' to 6' (150 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to Mildew. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
